words.example: Please write a debrief note once the auditors have left the site.
words.exampleZh: 审计人员离开现场之后，请写一份复盘说明。

words.example: I left a short thank-you note for the team that covered the holiday.
words.exampleZh: 我给顶了假期班的那个班组留了一封简短的感谢短笺。

words.example: The director sent her appreciation to the crew who worked the holiday.
words.exampleZh: 主任向假期值班的同事们表达了感谢认可。

words.example: Recognition for our long-serving clerks is planned for Friday's meeting.
words.exampleZh: 对长期服务文员的表彰安排在周五的会上。

words.example: The long-service award will be announced at the December staff meeting.
words.exampleZh: 长期服务奖项将在十二月的员工会上公布。

words.example: Hash reputation for this installer is unknown, so do not run it on a clinic PC.
words.exampleZh: 这个安装包的哈希信誉未知，不要在门诊电脑上运行。

words.example: Send me the file hash of the viewer build before it is pushed to the ward.
words.exampleZh: 阅片构建推到病区之前，先把文件哈希发给我。

words.example: SHA-256 (Secure Hash Algorithm 256) of the installer matches the value on the vendor site.
words.exampleZh: 安装包的 SHA-256（哈希算法）和厂商网站上的值一致。

words.example: MD5 (Message Digest 5) is too weak for new packages, so ask the vendor for SHA-256.
words.exampleZh: MD5（旧哈希算法）对新安装包来说太弱，向厂商要 SHA-256。

words.example: Quarantine the installer that Defender flagged before anyone on the ward runs it.
words.exampleZh: 病区有人运行之前，先把系统防护标出的那个安装包隔离掉。
